**Description**
This position is located in Seattle, WA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the AWS Vulnerability Management organization. Our organization is accountable for the end to end vulnerability lifecycle across all of AWS. Within the organization, our team owns host operating system vulnerability management, and our job is to mitigate the highest security risks at machine speed and at the lowest cost to AWS. We find the hardest security problems in our fleet, build prototypes, iterate fast, and reduce the attack surface so vulnerabilities never reach production hosts. Working with some of the largest services at AWS like EC2, S3, RDS, SageMaker, and Amazon Linux means diving deep into operating systems, fleet automation, and security data at AWS scale.
  
  
The successful candidate is one who turns a hard security problem into a service that solves it fleet wide. You will build the systems that determine why vulnerabilities persist across millions of hosts, predict which ones will become critical before they do, and drive remediation without a human in the loop, moving mean time to remediate down and cutting the engineering hours AWS spends on patching. You will work directly with AWS service teams and partner security teams, prototype fast, and take what works from prototype to production. You will set the engineering practice for a growing team and own what gets built.
  
  
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations: Seattle, WA
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Build the systems that determine why vulnerabilities persist across the AWS host fleet and drive them to remediation automatically.
  
  
Build detection that identifies where patching automation is not reaching hosts, and route what it finds to the owning team.
  
  
Prototype fast against fleet-scale security data, then take what works to production and own it there, including on-call.
  
  
Partner with AWS service teams and security platform teams to reduce the attack surface across the fleet.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will spend your days building and operating the systems that find and eliminate the causes of vulnerabilities across the AWS host fleet, at a scale where every decision has to be right the first time. You will prototype an idea, prove it against real fleet data, and take the ones that work into production. You will work directly with AWS service teams to turn what you find into remediation they can act on immediately. The team is security engineers with deep fleet expertise, a technical program manager, and a support engineer, and the engineering team is growing.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team owns host operating system vulnerability management for AWS. We find the hardest problems keeping vulnerabilities alive in the fleet, build the services that eliminate them, and work directly with the AWS service teams who run that fleet. You will build security services that protect AWS from real adversaries, at a scale where the solution has to be automatic. The engineering team is growing and the scope grows with it.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security?
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
  
  
Training & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig , Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings. Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.
About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Trase, you’ll build and deploy AI agents and applications that solve real customer problems using Trase OS. You’ll join Leagues , our industry verticals team, supporting customers in healthcare, state and local government and education (SLED), financial services, or retail. Your focus may be one or more of these verticals; experience in all four is not required.
This is a hands-on software engineering role with direct customer ownership. You’ll work with users to understand their workflows, turn unclear requirements into technical plans, and take solutions from prototype through production. You’ll partner closely with Product, ML, and the Origin and Arena engineering teams to build on Trase OS and feed customer needs back into the platform.
We are hiring at Mid, Senior and Staff levels. Level will reflect your demonstrated engineering depth, independence, and scope of ownership.
Why This Role is Needed
Customer value depends on how well AI works within existing systems, data, and day-to-day operations. Leagues connects Trase OS to those environments and turns platform capabilities into solutions customers can use and trust.
This role exists to:
Deliver working solutions that improve customer workflows and produce measurable outcomes.
Bridge customer needs and platform engineering, identifying gaps early and shaping practical solutions.
Turn successful deployments into reusable integrations and patterns that help future customers launch faster.
What makes this role challenging
Customer environments vary in data quality, integration options, security requirements, and operational readiness.
AI behavior must be evaluated against real workflows, including failure cases, escalation paths, and human review.
You must balance delivery speed with reliability and maintainability, while deciding what belongs in a customer solution versus the shared platform.
Responsibilities
Work directly with customers to map workflows, identify useful AI applications, and agree on scope, success measures, and acceptance criteria.
Build production-quality agents, applications, APIs, and integrations using Trase OS, including backend services and user interfaces as needed.
Integrate customer systems, data sources, and identity providers; work with infrastructure engineers to deploy in customer or Trase-managed environments.
Own delivery through testing, deployment, customer validation, and operational handoff. Surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes early.
Build evaluations, automated tests, observability, and human review or escalation into agent workflows; validate quality, latency, cost, and reliability.
Apply appropriate access controls, data-handling policies, and audit logging in partnership with Security and customer teams.
Debug production issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers; document solutions and create practical runbooks.
Contribute reusable components and product feedback to Origin and Arena; collaborate on platform improvements rather than maintaining unnecessary custom implementations.
Requirements
Experience building and shipping production software, with strong coding, testing, debugging, and API design fundamentals.
Proficiency in a modern language such as Python, Java or TypeScript, and experience with databases, backend services, and external integrations.
Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and monitoring; ability to troubleshoot deployed applications.
Ability to translate customer needs into implementable work and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Practical understanding of LLM applications or AI agents, including their limitations, evaluation, and safe interaction with customer data and systems.
Ownership of delivery and quality, curiosity about customer operations, and comfort working through incomplete requirements.
Nice to Have
Experience as a forward deployed, product, full stack, or solutions engineer with substantial production coding responsibility.
Domain experience in healthcare, SLED, financial services, or retail; familiarity with sensitive data and regulated customer environments.
Experience with agent orchestration, retrieval, LLM evaluations, enterprise identity, or complex enterprise integrations.

Engineer II (L4): Deliver scoped features and integrations with guidance; contribute to customer discovery, testing, and production troubleshooting.
Senior Engineer (L5): Independently lead a customer workstream from discovery to production, make design decisions, and mentor engineers.
Staff Engineer (L6): Lead complex deployments and architecture across teams, resolve broader technical risks, and establish reusable patterns across Leagues.

**AI Engineer.**

The
**AI Engineer**
will build AI-powered systems that automate and improve workflows for M3 USA’s healthcare businesses. The primary customers are non-technical business teams. **agentic coding**

* Monitor and maintain deployed solutions; iterate based on user feedback.
* Manage costs and provide input on AI tools and platform selection.
